packs.title: Unishop electronics store
packs.description: An electronics store with 20 products across phones, audio, watches, laptops, power and accessories: specs on every product, sale prices, variable products, brands, reviews, buying guides and store pages.

packs.title: Bytewell store for Twenty Twenty-Five
packs.description: A small electronics store in Twenty Twenty-Five's Noon style: a homepage with a trust strip, category tiles, a product spotlight, customer reviews, sale and featured products, 8 products, 3 categories, 2 brands, store pages and a journal.

packs.title: eBasket grocery store
packs.description: A neighbourhood grocer with 37 products in 8 aisles: pack sizes and nutrition panels on every food, diet tags, offers with end dates, a variable coffee, reviews, recipes, store pages and a demo checkout with free delivery over £40.

packs.title: Luma skincare formulary
packs.description: A skincare and beauty shop with 39 products in 8 categories: key actives with their strength, pH, texture, skin type, concern, routine step, size and full ingredients on every formula, two variable products sold by shade and one by size, offers with end dates, reviews, a journal, store pages and a demo checkout with free delivery over £35.

packs.title: Vitrena showroom
packs.description: An authorised dealer for considered electronics: 23 products from nine makers across hi-fi, headphones, watches, cameras, and desk and mobile, each with key figures, warranty and box contents; ex-display and certified pre-owned pieces, a variable phone, reviews, store pages, a journal and a demo checkout with free insured delivery over $500.

packs.title: Gadgetix gadget store
packs.description: A gadget store with 25 products in 6 gadget categories: what each works with (a filterable attribute), battery life, charging speed, capacity, water ratings, ports and real dimensions for the actual size drawing; drops with end dates, low and sold-out stock, a variable cable, reviews, buying guides, store pages and a demo checkout with free delivery over $50.
